recent.text: The #Isles power play is 4-for-12 (33.3%) over the last four games, scoring in each. Pete DeBoer on PP: “We don’t have necessarily a one and a two, we got kind of a one and a 1A, which is a nice luxury to have, too.” (H/t @NYIslanders)
recent.author: Stefen Rosner

recent.text: The #Isles have scored first in 5 straight games (3-0-2) & are 9-0-3 this season when opening the scoring. Pete DeBoer: “I think our group understands we’re a much better team playing in front.” (H/t @NYIslanders)
recent.author: Stefen Rosner

recent.text: Pete DeBoer likes where the #Isles are heading but wants to temper expectations. Pointed to a favorable schedule, rest, and fewer back-to-backs. Said they still have to prove themselves against the league’s best teams. (H/t @NYIslanders)
recent.author: Stefen Rosner

recent.text: Pete DeBoer on Logan Stanley: “What a great signing for us.” Said Stanley solidified the #Isles defense, bringing size, toughness, poise with the puck and underrated skating ability. Also said #GoJetsGo HC Scott Arniel gave Stanley a glowing report. (H/t @NYIslanders)
recent.author: Stefen Rosner

recent.text: Pete DeBoer on how long Cal Ritchie will remain in Hamilton: “I don’t know how long it’s going to be...until he gets up to game speed and is playing at a great level.” No set timetable for his #Isles return. (H/t @NYIslanders)
recent.author: Stefen Rosner

recent.text: Pete DeBoer on why #Isles sent Cal Ritchie to Hamilton: “What better way to get your reps in, to get your game up to speed, to get your power-play touches, so that when you jump in, you’re not playing catch-up.” Called it a “no-brainer.” (H/t @NYIslanders)
